analysis.executiveSummary: Rapid Valley Annihilation is currently in Retool mode (2-8, Seed 14) and looking to build future draft capital. However, including a 2028 2nd-round pick alongside 22-year-old starting running back Ollie Gordon II to acquire a single 2028 1st-round pick represents a significant overpay. Ollie Gordon II's recent workload spike in Miami (21.7 touches/game over the last three weeks, averaging 11.9 PPR PPG) makes him a highly usable asset for a title contender like Corgi Loaf Baking Co. (9-1, Seed 3). Rapid Valley should pull back the 2nd-round pick and offer Ollie Gordon II 1-for-1 for the 2028 1st, or at most include a 2028 3rd-round sweetener.
